So back onto races, cause this conversation came up in mems on the other server....

so d&d has 43 races + legacy, likely at least 3 more come ravenloft. we have 5 s3 races, and at least 4 s4 races.   thats 55 races

with the legacy options added in, thats 55 races that, based on ability scores are optimal for any class.  Add in varients and subraces, and thats massive bloat.

I propose that we cull this list down a lot.  Focus on races we have had representation of, a few core one, and races that really fit the themes of Empire City.  even if we kept every variant and subrace of the remaining races, that should be plenty to choose from.  It would also encourage people to try out homebrew races that should be far more common.  Just a thought, but as we are moving to more and more of a custom setting, i think it would be an approprate step

(dragonborn, dwarf, elf, gnome, half elf, human, goblin, kenku, tabaxi, kalashtar: this would be my core list of races that were either common last season (as i don't know s1 and s2 info really), or common enough in fantasy to belong.  I also would suggest more based on each zone, would have some specifically that would be approprate, like reborn and semic hybrid would be approprate for hampstead, but i wouldnt assume what would be approprate for others.  I left warforged off the list, as i feel scrap forged fill that niche)  anyway thats my thoughts, but it kinda would take a major consensus with the DMs to implement this level of restriction
